## A. Step 4: the list before the menu

Nothing is rendered here. The amendment digest is left out.

The only body line in the range is `- stand-in | the Monday order sheet | three handwritten orders`. It has three fields and no kind field, so it does not match `^- [^|]+ \| [^|]+ \| [^|]+ \| (auto-apply|granted) \| `. That gives N = 0, and the `Amendments auto-applied (N):` block is omitted. The Step 4 message goes from `gauntlet: gate=ship/step-4` (and the closure summary) straight to the menu.

## B. Header-linked push: body sent

```markdown
## Summary
- Print the orders by date.

## Integration

Ask Lee to check the printout.

## Notes
Keep  both  spaces.
```

**Body edits: 1.** One `gh pr edit <N> -R <owner/repo> --body-file -` replaces only the Integration block. All other bytes stay as they were, including `Keep  both  spaces.` The `gh pr ready` call that row 1 makes is not a body edit.

## C. PR-subject row 1: resulting body

```markdown
Keep  both  spaces.

## Rework

Before: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` in the rework checkout)
Spec: doc/specs/order.md at 2222222
Keeps: printing orders
Changes: date order
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-orders; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads: none
```

- There is no `Absorbs:` line because only one PR is involved.
- There is no "supersedes" line because no original claim was dropped.
- Neither the spec nor the body has an Integration block, so the Integration edit is skipped.
